title: PORTULAN EXTRAGLUE DATASETS AND MODELS: KICK-STARTING A BENCHMARK FOR THE NEURAL PROCESSING OF PORTUGUESE
reasoning: The paper describes the creation and evaluation of a Portuguese version of the GLUE and SuperGLUE benchmarks. While it includes a gender bias diagnostic dataset (AXg), it does not have any dedicated component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
